The only spec case uses `url = 'http://eviltrout.com/123'` (default port 80) and single-slash paths (`'/hello'`, `'/images/wat.jpg'`), so it does not exercise the non-80/443 port branch or multi-slash stripping. This is a concrete, diff-grounded missing edge-case test rather than a functional defect.
